---
title: "Drop the unused @payloadcms/next dependency"
description: "Drop when the pinned release's plugin-search no longer depends on @payloadcms/next."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream:export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

plugin-search lists @payloadcms/next as a runtime dependency but never imports
it. Installing the plugin in a TanStack Start site therefore installs all of
Next.js 16 and a next peer requirement. Removing the dependency changes nothing
at runtime.

- **Patch:** `plugin-search-no-next`, committed as `fix(plugin-search): drop the unused @payloadcms/next dependency`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm --filter @payloadcms/plugin-search build; e2e suite (search test) passes and e2e/ has no next package installed`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0002-fix-plugin-search-drop-the-unused-payloadcms-next-de.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0002-fix-plugin-search-drop-the-unused-payloadcms-next-de.patch)
